# RHAIIS 3.5.4 RC CVE Lists

**Generated 2026-11-24** for the proposed final RCs of the 3.5.4 z-stream,
for the release-notes owner (Giulia, per Selbi) and the
@aipcc-productization production-ready announcement.

Method: `quay-inspect` CVE scans (Quay/Clair) dispatched from the nm-cicd
PR #1691 branch — **main's `cves` operation is a stub** and returns no data.
Scan totals are vulnerability *entries* per feature; the lists below are
deduplicated unique CVE IDs. ROCm is covered by a trivy fallback because
Quay reports `manifest_layer_too_large` for that image (Clair cannot scan
it — platform limit, not an image defect).

## Notes

- Severity distribution and per-CVE details are in the scan artifacts
  (`cves.json` per run, nm-cicd).
- Model-opt's CVE findings are the same set referenced as the separate
  security disposition on INFERENG-10508.
- The 3.4.7 precedent for the announcement format: @aipcc-productization
  post with the image list, CVEs in thread, per variant.

## 3.5.3 comparison — CVEs fixed in 3.5.4 (2026-11-24)

For [RHAI-14403](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/RHAI-14403)
"Determine CVEs fixed in rhaiis 3.5.4" (closed with this determination):

- Method: before/after Clair scans of the released 3.5.3 and 3.5.4
  images, all five variants, unique-CVE diff, digests verified distinct.
- **Result: zero net CVEs fixed** — identical unique-CVE sets between
  releases (CPU 150/150, CUDA 140/140, Spyre 142/142, Model-opt 89/89).
  The z-stream's changes (CPU memory fix, bart 0.6.3, base 3.5.7
  refresh) did not alter the Clair-detectable vulnerable package set.
- ROCm: unscannable by Clair on both releases
  (`manifest_layer_too_large`); 3.5.4 covered by trivy above.
- 3.5.3 baseline scan runs: 45434780410 (CPU), 45434794125 (CUDA),
  45434809451 (ROCm), 45434825835 (Spyre), 45434845053 (Model-opt).
